item_verdicts.diff: The reviewed node landed no repository change; its worktree head equals base e11fa99fb9d6ee575d37ad3ea009e73a75280227 and is clean, so the diff against base is empty and the deliverable is the measurement and its logs rather than code.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names two logs from one exclusive job, each naming its revision, host and literal command, proving reckon.__file__ lies under its own checkout, carrying pytest's summary line and ending in EXIT=, plus alone-runs of every added id five times at each revision; gate-base.log:1 and gate-candidate.log:1 carry the labelled header, MODULE_FILE lines under their own checkouts, the summaries "1 failed, 917 passed" / "1 failed, 922 passed" and EXIT=1, job-1287829.log records one exclusive all_debug job, and no id was added so that alone-run clause is satisfied vacuously while the six earlier load-only ids were run 5x at each revision (repeats/summary.txt, every row 0/5).

item_verdicts.manifest: Read /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261017T015647690493-held-worktree-match-once-repaired-population-at-merge/manifest.md; status complete, commits none, tests line records both arms' counts with their log paths, baseline_suite and after_suite carry the two revisions with the single failing id each, and failure_attribution is empty.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The source manifest declares one report path under the plan's reports directory; the node wrote only there plus its own run directory (manifest.md, the two gate logs, the id-set files, repeats/, job log), and no path under reckon/ or tests/ changed, confirmed by the reviewed worktree /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/reckon-c8f839407e49/f653840f-3ca8-4792-819c-9ee9708bdbac/held-worktree-match-once-repaired-population-at-merge sitting clean at its base revision.

justifications.durability: the node adds no assertion and no code, so no repository test guards this measurement, but the empty added set is a measured absence backed by a demonstrated positive control (job-1287829.log reports BASE-FAILED 1 / CAND-FAILED 1, the parse seeing the one real failure in each arm) rather than an instrument that reads nothing.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log and gate-candidate.log each carry a revision/host/command header, a MODULE_FILE line under their own checkout, the pytest summary and EXIT=, and the failure-id sets in base-failed-ids.txt and cand-failed-ids.txt are equal (added-ids.txt empty), so the done_when's measure is recorded, not merely claimed.
justifications.fit: the gate logs, id-set files and manifest (manifest.md:1) follow the run's declared artefact idiom with no plan label, stage name or revision tag leaked into source.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the candidate arm's file set (gate-candidate.log:1) is byte-identical to the 105-file population list and the base arm's is that list minus the one candidate-added file, so the measurement covers exactly the population the goal names.
justifications.reuse: the node adds no source definition at all (commits none, changed_paths none), so there is no capability to fork; a search of the reviewed tree over reckon/crew found no competing population-reading mechanism the node re-implemented.
justifications.scope_discipline: every artefact the node produced lies under its declared report path or its own run directory and the reviewed worktree is clean at base, so no path under reckon/ or tests/ was touched.
